usage: Controlled fixtures only for explicitly scoped local/staging QA rooms. These are module sources, not complete proposals; use the current Advanced schema, own QA IDs/ports and monotonically increasing version. Never apply to an existing business room.

javascript.throw-error: export default function compute(inputs) { throw new Error("QA controlled failure"); }
javascript.wrong-output-type: export default function compute(inputs) { return { total: "wrong type" }; }
javascript.non-finite-number: export default function compute(inputs) { return { total: Infinity }; }
javascript.fresh-counter: let counter = 0; export default function compute(inputs) { counter += 1; return { counter }; }
